description:
v2.0.0 validation matrix and scripted test plan. Design only; no test files, no CI, no helper or Electron code, no benchmark execution. Locks test rows, severity tiers (smoke / must-pass / rc / regression / soak / nice-to-have), hardware/environment matrix (M1 NVIDIA-KDE smoke, M2 AMD-GNOME, M3 Intel/Arc-KDE, M4 Intel-wlroots, M5 manual UX, W1 future-Windows placeholder), synthetic loads (L-MOTION-60, L-STATIC, L-CHANGE, L-RESIZE, L-MINIMIZE, L-PORTAL-DENY, L-SOURCE-REMOVE, L-COMP-PAUSE, L-DISK-SLOW, L-DISK-FULL, L-CRASH-CAP, L-CRASH-EXP, L-AUDIO-SYNC), and pass/fail thresholds (0 drops at 1080p/1440p on HW; ≤0.1% at 4K60 NVENC/VAAPI; duration ±1 frame at 60 s / ±50 ms at 5 min; frame count = round(duration × declared_fps) ± 1 to kill fake-60fps; replay.save ≤ 250 ms + fragment latency; HUD ≥ 1 Hz during SAVING; exactly-one terminal event per exportId; ≤ 3 restarts in 60 s; no leftover cove-replay-engine/ffmpeg/pactl 5 s after shutdown; helper sha256 mismatch blocks boot). Validation areas covered: VAL-CAP (capture, including Issue #3 minimised-source proof and Issue #1 region overlay), VAL-ENC (probe success/failure/cache, fallbackEngaged, no mid-session switching, no blind retry loops, libx264 universal fallback, Linux re-encode libx264-only, AMF future-slot visibly inert), VAL-SEG (rolling buffer, atomic commit, pin-defers-eviction, slow disk, disk full, crash recovery with committed-only segments), VAL-EXP (fast stream-copy, lead-trim re-encode, discontinuity re-encode, max-compat full re-encode, cancel before/after MUXING boundary, exactly-once terminal events, faststart, no fake-60fps, real cadence preserved), VAL-UI (FSM coverage, RECORDING reachable only via capture.sessionReady, HUD non-freeze during SAVING — Issue #4, three clocks independence, recovery prompt non-modal, helper sha256/protocol blocking modals, hotkeys, dependency probe), VAL-REC (crash mid-cap / mid-exp, restart loop bound, orphan adoption, stale socket/pid scrub), VAL-PROC (paired post-condition with every capture/export row + standalone IDLE/RECORDING/SAVING/EXPORTING/SIGKILL rows, PDEATHSIG on Linux, Job Object on Windows, pactl NEVER spawned), VAL-PERF (15-min soak at 1080p60/1440p60/4K60 across HW encoder paths, save spam, concurrent export). v1.1.0 regression suite consolidated as VAL-REG-001..013 covering replay corruption, fake duplicated-frame 60fps, replay freeze during save, broken Linux HW fallback loops, audio sidecar (future), save state, source diagnostics, FPS/cadence detection, process cleanup, no leftover ffmpeg/pactl, no hover/DOM/canvas dependency, no timer-based readiness guessing. Issue #1/#3/#4 absorption proofs are triple-classified must-pass/smoke/regression. Resolution × encoder coverage gate locks which cells must be green for GA (1080p60 × all encoders; 1440p60 × NVENC/VAAPI/QSV; 4K60 × NVENC/VAAPI/QSV); 4K60 libx264 is nice-to-have with back-pressure mandatory; AMF and WGC remain visibly inert in v2.0.0. Smoke suite is 18 rows in ≤ 30 min on M1+M5. RC suite is 4–6 h on M1+M2+M3+M4 including soak. Manual/scripted-local/future-CI classification recorded. ffprobe/mediainfo check recipes specified at spec level for duration, declared fps, frame count, duplicated-PTS, real cadence, faststart, codec, GOP/fragment structure. v1.1.0 vs v2.0.0 comparison protocol defined (structural, not parity — v1.1.0 cannot pass 1440p/4K60). §24 release-gate checklist is the exact list T-010 consumes. Full design lives in N-008.

Out of scope: implementation, test files, source/CI edits, helper code, Electron code, packaging changes, runner harness, synthetic asset binaries, release execution, Windows hardware, audio gating, 4K60 success claim (acceptance plan only).
title: Plan validation matrix for 1080p60, 1440p60, and 4K60
